title: Please Stay On The Line
description: Sal just wants to cancel a free trial of a streaming service called Lull before it bills him. The cancellation hotline put him on hold, and his queue position is going up, then sideways, then into physics. Todd the intern was sent to hold the line three years ago and is having a lovely time.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: You're on Snazzie FM. Our next caller's trying to cancel a free trial before it bills him, and the cancellation line has him on hold. Sal, you're on the air.

lines.speaker: caller-sal
lines.text: Hey, Ronnie. Yeah, I got the streaming thing, Lull, free for a week, and I just wanna CANCEL before they charge me. <p:0.3> I called the hotline. I've been holding nine minutes.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Nine minutes isn't bad. What's it say?

lines.speaker: phone
lines.text: Your call is important to us. You are caller number forty one thousand. Please stay on the line.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Forty one THOUSAND?

lines.speaker: caller-sal
lines.text: Yeah, but it's fine, it's moving, right? It said forty one thousand when I started too. <p:0.3> So it's holding steady.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Now hold on. Steady's good, Sal. Steady means stable. Let's let the line work.

lines.speaker: phone
lines.text: Your call is important to us. You are still caller number forty one thousand. Please stay on the line.

lines.speaker: caller-sal
lines.text: See? Forty one thousand. <p:0.3> It hasn't gone DOWN, but it hasn't gone up. I can live with that.

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: Don't trust the steady part, friend.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Who is that? Sal, is somebody on your line?

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: I'm in the same queue. Deeper than him. <p:0.3> I was you, friend. Forty one thousand. I held steady too. <p:0.4> For a while.

lines.speaker: caller-sal
lines.text: How long's a while?

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: [sigh] A while.

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: Still holding, boss! <p:0.3> Oh hey, is that the show? It's Todd! I'm on the line!

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Todd? Our Todd? Ronnie, didn't we send Todd to hold a line for the cable refund?

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: We did. Todd, buddy. What year do you think it is?

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: Day one, boss! Great news, by the way, the queue's looking awesome. Real healthy numbers.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Todd, that was three years ago.

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: Three years of progress, boss! Imagine where we'll be by lunch.

lines.speaker: caller-sal
lines.text: Okay, whatever, I'm not waiting three years to cancel a SEVEN DAY trial. Hello? Hotline? <p:0.3> I just wanna CANCEL!

lines.speaker: phone
lines.text: Your call is important to us. Your position is the same as the speed of light. Please stay on the line.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Your position is WHAT?

lines.speaker: caller-sal
lines.text: That's not a position! That's not even a NUMBER, that's a speed! I've been holding twenty minutes, no, an hour, no... <p:0.3> what day is it?

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: Don't count, friend. Counting's how it gets you. <p:0.3> I counted minutes. Then days. Then I stopped. It's a while now. It's all a while.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Now hold on, hold on. Sal, you're on the air, stay with me. It's a busy day at the call center, that's all.

lines.speaker: phone
lines.text: Your call is important to us. Your position is a constant of the universe. It does not change. It cannot change. Please stay on the line.

lines.speaker: caller-sal
lines.text: A CONSTANT? You can't put me on hold behind PHYSICS!

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Just hang up, Sal! Hang up the phone!

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: There's no hanging up. The only way off the line is to be connected.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Then get connected!

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: Connection isn't a thing that happens to people, friend. <p:0.3> I was you.

lines.speaker: caller-sal
lines.text: CANCEL!

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Hang up!

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: Still holding!

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: I was you.

lines.speaker: phone
lines.text: Please stay on the line.

lines.speaker: caller-sal
lines.text: Please stay on the line!

lines.speaker: phone
lines.text: Thank you for your patience. <p:0.4> You are now first in line.

lines.speaker: caller-sal
lines.text: ...First? <p:0.3> I'm first? It worked? It actually...

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: Great news, boss! The line MOVED! <p:0.3> You're caller number forty one thousand and ONE!

lines.speaker: caller-sal
lines.text: That's HIGHER. That's a higher number, Todd!

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: Progress, boss!

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Well, Sal, sounds like you're almost through page one. <p:0.4> We'll stay on the line. <p:0.3> We don't really have a choice.

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: Oh, and boss? I added you and Barry to the queue. <p:0.3> So we'd be together.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: You did WHAT? Ronnie, hang up the studio phone. <p:0.3> Ronnie, it won't hang up.

lines.speaker: phone
lines.text: Your call is important to us. Please stay on the line.
